data.title: Spectinomycin
data.summary: Other antibacterials · Aminocyclitol antibiotic (related to aminoglycosides)
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Other antibacterials_

**Class:** Aminocyclitol antibiotic (related to aminoglycosides)

## Mechanism of action
- Binds 30S ribosomal subunit → inhibits protein synthesis (bacteriostatic)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Gonorrhoea (urogenital/anorectal) in patients allergic to cephalosporins or in pregnancy — not effective for pharyngeal gonorrhoea
- Disseminated gonococcal infection (older regimens)

## Dose & formulations
- 2 g IM single dose; DGI 2 g IM daily (older regimens)

## Adverse effects
- Injection-site pain, urticaria, fever, nausea (uncommon)

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity

## Pregnancy & lactation
Considered safe (old FDA category B).

## Viva points
- Gonorrhoea alternative — poor pharyngeal activity; largely unavailable now

_Sources: Khopkar ch.1 (Spectinomycin). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
